title: Defining dialects
preamble:
# Defining dialects

The dialect system as an integrator meets it: defining a dialect —
a setting of every capability — for the programs on a given
tier, and wiring that definition into the compiler. What an
integration admits at load is [NLFC.10].

Paired with:

- [LDIA] — language-level contract: what `use` means, grammar,
  compile-time validation.
- [RBND] — how a compiled program's settings are carried and verified.

## What this is not

- Not the language spec. Rule authors read [LDIA].
- Not the capability registry. Authoritative table lives at [LCAP].
- Not a deployment topology guide.
